claims: Michigan defeated Arizona 91-73 in the 2026 Men's Final Four semifinal on April 4, 2026.
Michigan advanced to the NCAA Tournament national championship game to play UConn on April 6, 2026.
Aday Mara scored 26 points and had 9 rebounds for Michigan.
Trey McKenney scored 16 points for Michigan.
Koa Peat scored 16 points and had 11 rebounds for Arizona.
Michigan reached a 30-point margin over Arizona in the second half.
Michigan became the first team in Men's NCAA Tournament history to score at least 90 points and win by double digits in five consecutive games.
